name: exp027b_paired_padded_pilot
notes: EXP-027b LOCAL falsifiability pilot (not a registered test). Reference = main = 500 m / dt 100 s so that it costs core-hours, not tens; control = 2 km / dt 400. Question: with 48 cases per draw, is the replicate-pair displacement of 500 m layouts below the 500 m -> 2 km displacement within a draw? 4 draws (seeds 1101-1104) x 48 cases; cases are a nested prefix of the n_cases draw (rng sequential), so sub-ensembles of 6/12/24 are the first cases.
